coverage: Original nearby-probe prefix and supplied locomotor receiver queries; excludes full nearby-object scan and startup.

functions.name: PathfinderClass__FindNearbyBridgePeer
functions.plate_comment:
Algorithm:
Fallback peer search used by PathfinderClass::UpdateBridgePassability when the probe's selected object-list head is null. Input center is the original packed probe CellStruct; requested_height is signed probe Cell+0x11B plus 4 only when the caller selected the deck list. Build the query Coord3D as signed-i16 x/y * 256 + 128 and z = g_LevelHeightLeptons * requested_height.

Scan exact 5x5 order: outer dy=-2..2, inner dx=-2..2, packed-i16 additions, no playfield clamp. For each candidate Cell choose Cell+0xE8 only when flags+0x140 has 0x100 and abs(signed Cell+0x11B - requested_height)>2; otherwise Cell+0xE4. Walk Object+0x30 in list order. Require Object+0x14 bit 0x04 (FootClass-derived; constructor sets it), nonnull Object+0x674 locomotor, and ILocomotion vtable slot 40 (+0xA0) Is_At_Coord at the original probe-center Coord3D/requested z. Return the first match; otherwise null after all 25 lists.

Receivers:
Slot 40 resolves to active DriveLocomotionClass::Is_At_Coord @ 0x004B4920 and WalkLocomotionClass::Is_At_Coord @ 0x0075CA80. Caller then handles only the returned object's Object+0x30 suffix, not other fallback cells.

2026-10-01 executed query-input/receiver controls (tools/spatial_oracle/locomotor_at_coord.py/.json/.meta.json): original42B080 prefix through stop-before42B0F8 builds XYZ [1408,1152,0] for cell(5,4), [128,128,0] for(0,0), and[-128,-128,0] for(-1,-1). All three requested heights are zero; original89C2D8 bytes are00000000 and no startup/global-height claim is made by this prefix witness. Original locomotor slot40 queries on the supplied retained states return true,false,true respectively. A Drive track handoff and head can occupy the same integer cell while their Z differs; Is_At_Coord admits the handoff OR the head, not a selected head-Z summary. A fully NullCoord Drive head rejects the center probe. Signed division of negative centers can alias cell0, so comparing the original packed cell words directly is not equivalent. The prefix executes no Map lookup/nearby-list scan; the receiver tests exclude placement, scheduling and whole nearby-search parity. Three cases are additive; all prior336 inputs/results and8 false controls remain unchanged.

comments.pre_comment: FindNearbyBridgePeer scans dy=-2..2 outer, dx=-2..2 inner using packed i16 additions and Get_CellClass. It does not clamp or call Is_Cell_In_Playfield; allocated Size-diamond halo cells are searched and unallocated coordinates read the shared dummy's empty lists.

comments.eol_comment: ILocomotion slot40 Is_At_Coord receiver dispatch. Verified active Ship vtable 0x007F2D8C resolves this slot to ShipLocomotionClass__Is_At_Coord @ 0x006A3F50 (in addition to other locomotors).
